findings.category: Finite observer report completeness and interpretation gate
findings.title: Validate actual row contracts and load/seed/count relations before declaring a complete observer report

evidence.fact: The summary is parsed, but the loop below it accepts site and skin rows solely from their family label/count. Their fields, domains and relations are not parsed.

Mark rows receive only an order/draw substring check and a loose kind extraction. There is no required load_begin/load_end or constructor balance/domain check; only the first and last indexed marks must contain kind=seed.

The coherent REPORT fixture is available, but the current damage controls exercise only summary flags/totals/row count and one mark ordinal; they do not reject missing or contradictory load/site/skin evidence.

The plan requires malformed/count/order contradictions to fail before absence credit and declares real seed bounds, balanced constructor/skin/site traffic and a completed load as the interpretation contract.

source_supported_counterexamples: Keep the coherent fixture otherwise unchanged and replace its load_begin or load_end kind token with an unrelated kind. The summary remains complete1/loads1/ends1, all row counts and monotone mark ordinals pass, and the boundary-prefix checks ignore the unrecognized kind. No actual completed load is then established by the rows.
Keep the same fixture and replace one site body with core-crt-site garbage, or a skin body with core-crt-skin garbage. The family/count checks still pass and the driver writes/logs a complete report.
A single altered site phase count can contradict the summary phase totals without affecting any current check. These are source-walk counterexamples, not reviewer-executed tests or native results.
findings.impact: Malformed or internally inconsistent evidence can receive the same successful complete-report path as a real bounded capture. That can turn missing load/constructor/skin or phase evidence into misleading absence/zero-draw credit. No production loader/RNG defect is asserted.
findings.minimum_correction: Use the existing report family and driver to parse the complete exact current summary/mark/site/skin schemas, canonical numeric domains and family order. Join summary counts and draw phases to the rows; require the real ordered load begin/end and seed bounds, permitted ordered boot-boundary prefix, balanced constructor/skin relationships and meaningful first/last ordinals. Preserve legitimate inactive skin and genuinely outside-window marks as qualified absence, rather than requiring a preferred reseed location or changing the window. Do not introduce a replacement observer framework.
required_controls: Start with the current coherent accepted fixture and retain successful exact-copy/delegation. Apply each missing-boundary, unknown-kind, malformed-site/skin and contradictory phase/ordinal mutation singly; each must fail for its own evidence error.
Keep the legitimate earlier-reseed prefix positive and inactive-skin zero-draw case. Do not force later boot boundaries to appear after capture already froze.

Run only the affected Lua/report-control, formatting/lint and identity checks for a Lua/test/docs-only correction. Reuse exact unchanged C forwarding/staging evidence rather than replaying old matrices or retail runs.

source_review_assessment.forwarding: The feature wrappers undefine their own macros for the real rand/srand calls, forward each original call once with the original seed conversion and return rand int unchanged. They preserve the underlying errno result around integer/static bookkeeping and introduce no hook I/O/allocation/time/extra RNG call. Capture freezes at the first actual seed in the post-load phase while later calls continue forwarding.
source_review_assessment.staging: The eight additive patch rules surround the two actual FOREST source alternatives, CLOUD construction and skin_random boundaries, and preserve existing RNG expressions. Source anchor counts and the actual compiled-stage equality control bind the staged text, not merely an uncompiled copied fixture. The original branch/season/cloud expression is not repaired or normalized.
source_review_assessment.gating: Cargo forwards the opt-in feature dc to engine to sys. The C observer body is entirely guarded and the generic csrc loop compiles it once; the force include and staging patches are feature-gated. Lua/Rust report methods are absent from default builds. Target-point-fixture is explicitly incompatible. Default shipping is not relabelled as this observer.
source_review_assessment.bounds_and_FFI: Static site64/mark64/skin128 bounds record problem rather than overwrite, and forwarding continues. The report writer returns an error for insufficient capacity; the Rust wrapper uses a fixed65536-byte buffer and only reads a successful NUL-terminated result. The gated engine report entry uses the existing ENTER/LEAVE state/poison/FPU boundary. Unsafe C test entry strings/buffers are controlled by the isolated test; no public reset/arming API is added.
source_review_assessment.FPU_thread_limits: The small real-CRT forwarding control demonstrates its recorded FP words and call sequence, not whole campaign/Windows/provider FPU noninterference. Integer bookkeeping alone does not supply a universal compiler/register/trap guarantee. The observer assumes the supported one owner thread/process and is not a synchronized whole-process CRT monitor.
source_review_assessment.coverage_truth: Observed site counts/first ordinals/first-last values and32-bit digest are compact Core-call-expression evidence, not a collision-free per-draw trace or Host/library-internal RNG coverage. Source functions shared by several callers may still require source/value-use attribution; ambiguous first consumer evidence stays OPEN. No zero-draw claim follows merely from an unobserved FOREST path or a frozen later boundary.
